result.title: JUBILEE: A Benchmark Environment for Off-Policy Evaluation in Debt Collections
result.comment: 28 pages, 3 figures, 35 tables. Code: https://github.com/alpha-synthesis/jubilee. Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24008544
result.summary: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) estimates the value a candidate decision policy would achieve, using only data logged by the policy already in production. In debt collections, unrecorded factors can influence both actions and outcomes. This paper presents JUBILEE, a benchmark environment built around a debt-collections simulator that generates million-loan panels with competing risks, rare recovery events, and hidden factors driving both outcomes and assignment. The evaluation includes an 80-run comparison of tabular and gradient-boosted estimators under two synthetic outcome mechanisms and a 190-run parameter grid. Independent policy simulations provide reference values with estimated Monte Carlo uncertainty for a synthetic reward score and for simulated cash. With hidden factors influencing action assignment, several tabular methods agree closely while underestimating the field-visit policy's score, an error that also appears with boosted models. Intervals from tabular doubly robust estimation usually contain the reference without hidden assignment dependence but mostly miss it when that dependence is present. Estimates from randomized decisions do not show the same large error, although their limited precision leaves policy choice uncertain. The decision consequences depend on how policy value is defined. The field-visit policy ranks last under the score and first under simulated cash, which excludes channel costs. Under cash, log-based estimators miss this best candidate in nearly every run with hidden assignment dependence in the paired study. JUBILEE supports reproducible study of these failure modes under specified collections mechanisms.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 JUBILEE：一个基于债务催收模拟器的 off-policy evaluation 基准环境，生成含竞争风险、稀有回收事件和同时影响动作分配的隐藏因子的贷款面板，并大规模比较 tabular 与 gradient-boosted 估计器的偏差、区间覆盖与决策后果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心发现——隐藏因子共变于动作与结果时策略价值估计系统性失效、且最优策略排序随价值定义改变——可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 等策略在日志数据下的离线评估与混淆敏感性核查提供思路。
